phase1_initial_proposals.technology_specification: Rotary Tablet Press machine designed for high-speed tablet production, featuring multiple tooling stations on a rotating turret to compress pharmaceutical powders into tablets. It integrates robust mechanical and structural assemblies for precise die and punch operation under continuous rotary motion.

The rotary design with multiple tooling stations is predominant for commercial manufacturing since the 20th century and remains standard as of 2024.
